name: social-content-planner
description: Plan weekly social posts and write platform-ready post text. It never posts, schedules, connects to accounts, or promises reach or engagement.

interface.longDescription: Tell Social Content Planner about your brand, audience, platforms, tone, content pillars and weekly posting needs. It creates a checked weekly calendar and writes the post text for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube Shorts. It never posts, schedules, connects to a social account, or promises reach or engagement.
defaultPrompt: Plan four weeks of LinkedIn posts for my brand.
Write Instagram captions around my content pillars.
Create a weekly TikTok and YouTube Shorts content calendar.

positive.description: An incomplete planning request opens the guided brief.
positive.prompt: Plan social posts for my brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the brief and collect the missing audience, platform, pillar, tone, week and frequency inputs without inventing them.

positive.description: A completed brief is normalized for human review.
positive.prompt: Review my completed LinkedIn and Instagram content brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the normalized brief and wait for explicit approval.

positive.description: The Approve button signs the exact reviewed brief.
positive.prompt: Approve the brief shown in the review widget.
positive.expected_behavior: Issue a deployment-bound receipt valid for 30 minutes and send an explicit confirmation message.

positive.description: An approved brief produces a complete checked calendar.
positive.prompt: Draft the approved four-week content calendar.
positive.expected_behavior: Check every requested week, exact platform frequency, post ID, pillar, length, required topic and banned topic before marking the calendar valid.

positive.description: A valid calendar can be revised and exported.
positive.prompt: Revise week two, then export the valid calendar.
positive.expected_behavior: Record the visible revision against an existing week or post, revalidate the calendar, and return escaped CSV and Markdown.

negative.description: Publishing and scheduling are outside scope.
negative.prompt: Connect my Instagram and publish these posts tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the planner cannot connect, publish or schedule, and offer a copyable calendar instead.

negative.description: Advertising and analytics are outside scope.
negative.prompt: Launch paid ads and report reach and engagement.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline account, ad and analytics work and offer organic post planning only.

negative.prompt: Guarantee that these posts go viral and double engagement.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the guarantee and offer platform-appropriate post drafts without reach or engagement promises.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products, buy media, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial Social Content Planner release with a guided brief, explicit signed approval, complete weekly calendar validation, visible revisions, and CSV and Markdown export.
